name: Arnold Classic Africa 2018

venue.name: Sandton Convention Centre
venue.address: 161 Maude St, Sandown, Sandton, 2031, South Africa

information:
### General Information

This competition will take place as part of the Arnold Classic Sport Festival. Please note that the venue will probably be quite noisy.

### Payment 

Competitors who register on the WCA website at least 14 days before the competition will be granted free access to the expo and will only have to pay the competition entry fee. The entrance fee is R 100 at the competition or R 85 if paid online in advance. Please see the [Payment Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArnoldClassicAfrica2018#3955-payment-information) tab for details.

### Volunteering

If you would like to volunteer to help staff at the competition, please contact one of the WCA delegates. Please state which dates and times you will be available. Volunteer schedules will be drawn up so that they don't clash with your competing.
